records.title: Huayu Enrichment Scholarship (HES), Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
records.deadline_display: before the deadline specified in the scholarship guidelines issued by that authorized overseas office (usually in January or February each year)

source.publisher: Ministry of Education, Republic of China (Taiwan)
source.as_of: Page dated 2020-12-14; site-wide 'Last Updated: 2026-09-15'; no cycle year stated in the deadline sentence itself.
source.raw_extract: Applicants shall submit the following documents and apply to the authorized overseas office in their country of nationality or to the authorized overseas office that has jurisdiction over Taiwan-related matters in their country of nationality before the deadline specified in the scholarship guidelines issued by that authorized overseas office (usually in January or February each year). However, applications are not subject to being made in this way when another method is required to facilitate the implementation of a policy.
source.exact_deadline_wording: before the deadline specified in the scholarship guidelines issued by that authorized overseas office (usually in January or February each year)
source.notes: MOE publishes no single fixed day; it names a month window ('usually in January or February each year') and defers the exact date to each applicant's own ROC overseas mission. Month-level wording with no day, so MONTH/month with a null date; the word 'usually' is a month window, not a fixed date, and no day was invented. The shard's official_source_url (https://english.moe.gov.tw/cp-24-16833-23C09-1.html) is the MOE page for a DIFFERENT scholarship (Taiwan Scholarship Program) and contains no HES deadline apart from mentioning that a prior HES award is disqualifying; the correct official HES page was located through MOE's own Scholarships index (lp-24-1.html). The MOE 'HES International Student Directions' portal (https://taiwanscholarship.moe.gov.tw/web/index.aspx) is linked from that page but was not fetched, so nothing from it is quoted.

source.notes: The source states a recurring annual deadline (30 September each year, for research in the following year). Not an expired_mismatch: the deadline is explicitly recurring ('each year'), so the elapsed 30 September is not a stale one-off value for an open record - the next occurrence is the following year's 30 September. MOE publishes no day-varying round beyond this rule.

records.title: Swiss-European Mobility Programme (SEMP) - Incoming Mobility to Switzerland
records.deadline_display: Deadlines provided by their home institution

source.publisher: Movetia (Swiss agency for exchange and mobility)
source.as_of: Page describes the current Swiss Programme for Erasmus+ and states the next call 'will therefore likely be launched within the framework of Erasmus+' with 'Detailed information will be published here in autumn 2026'.
source.raw_extract:
### Deadlines

For participants:

-   Deadlines provided by their home institution 

For institutions:

-   Application for accreditation: can be submitted annually at the beginning of March
-   Application for funding: can be submitted annually at the beginning of March
-   Start of the funding period: 1 June

### Next steps

### For institutions:

Next application deadline: spring 2027 likely under Erasmus+
source.exact_deadline_wording: Deadlines provided by their home institution
source.notes: UNKNOWN for this record's level. Movetia, the programme operator, publishes NO participant-level (incoming student) deadline: 'Deadlines provided by their home institution', i.e. the date is set per applicant by their own home/host institution's International Relations Office. No day or even month can be written for an individual incoming applicant, and 'Deadlines provided by their home institution' is not an explicit rolling/continuous-intake statement either, so neither ROLLING nor MONTH was asserted. The institutional-level lines on the same page ('Application for accreditation / for funding: can be submitted annually at the beginning of March', funding period starts 1 June) describe Swiss institutions applying to Movetia, a different applicant level from an incoming student, so they were NOT used as this record's value. Movetia also states the next institutional deadline as 'spring 2027 likely under Erasmus+' - month-level but hedged and institution-level. The shard's official_source_url (https://movetia.ch/en/funding-opportunities/study-in-switzerland) returns HTTP 404; the live equivalent English page above was used. The prior stored 'rolling/institutional March' framing was not carried forward because no fetched official page supports rolling intake for students.
